scope: One user-described Manli RTX 4080 SUPER; PCI10DE:2702/subsystem41401458, VBIOS95.03.44.40.09, port2/address0x25. No compatibility allowlist.
transport: Product NvAPI I2CReadEx V3, two-byte command/value prefix, one-byte response; independent ordinary one-byte complete-control readback.
limits: FB ADC is controller input telemetry in 10mV quanta, not calibrated physical rail voltage.
Requested offset and observed FB change are distinct; no fixed transfer gain is established.
Max runs use the real Druta oc_max callback, actual fans100%, maximum reported power limit, boost100%, de-flattened curve and owned V/F P0 hold.
The 1125mV-cap run was clamped by the1100mV rail ceiling; automatic headroom refused. Later1100mV-cap runs applied a session-only26mV margin; persistent default25mV remained unchanged.
No3D/heavy load; private harness checks measured low-load condition and software voltage readings within1200mV.

Historical strict-clock runs remain inconclusive. Current uP9512R verification treats core and memory frequencies as diagnostic only, including missing values, and skips CUDA/frequency settling. P0, exact held-voltage ownership, voltage noise/rise/reversal and restoration remain checked.
v1 58142 Max preflight stopped before writes on an incorrect expectation that saved headroom was26mV; corrected to session-only26mV.
A five-rung default staircase stays within the existing normal50mV offset range and1200mV verification ceiling, filtering steps against current offsets/baseline.
